globalRules: Every tutorial may be skipped immediately, replayed from the Tutorials shelf, and read later in the dialogue log where applicable.
Tutorial completion never unlocks a feature, spends a resource, grants a reward, changes Rank, or blocks passive progress.
At most one tutorial competes with one story or arrival scene on a safe visit; story resolution and arrival ordering win.
If the canonical speaker cannot render with a transparent cutout, use an approved framed treatment or text-only presentation.
No tutorial uses an unframed full-background portrait in Village dialogue.
Tutorial text uses localization keys and stable semantic step IDs; layout must survive 30 percent text expansion.
